_comment: Repo-local Daedalus policy for the Chronicle Visual Lab trial. This file was installed directly rather than through init_repo so PnP's CLAUDE/STATUS/design-lineage files and agent templates remain untouched.
name: PnP_App

policy._comment_write_allow: Fail-closed write surface: an entry without a trailing slash names exactly one file. Daedalus candidates may change App.tsx and nothing else.
policy._comment_egress: Only the candidate file may be sent to an untrusted external model through Daedalus context assembly. Generic secret and credential denies are still merged by the policy loader.
policy._comment_high_risk: These project-control and design-authority surfaces remain explicitly high-risk even though write_allow already excludes them.

_comment_test: Verifier uses shlex.split with shell=False. cmd /d /s /c is therefore required so npm ci and the requested root-relative build compose correctly on Windows. npm ci is necessary because disposable git worktrees do not contain ignored node_modules.
test_command: cmd /d /s /c "npm.cmd --prefix design/visual-lab ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm.cmd --prefix design/visual-lab run build"
_comment_test_timeout: Measured 2026-07-29: existing checkout build 12.83 s; clean exported checkout npm ci plus build 25.86 s; fresh linked-worktree command through daedalus.verifier 13.86 s with a warm npm cache. 180 s is a runaway guard with about 7x headroom over the slowest observed run for concurrent-load and registry variance.
